name: The Secret Service
description: Follow The Secret Service, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Inside the heightened security for the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner
changes.summary: The Secret Service says there has been a significant rise in threats ahead of the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner. CBS News' Nicole Sganga has more details.

changes.title: Member of Vance's Secret Service detail under investigation for leaking
changes.summary: The Secret Service said a member of Vice President JD Vance's detail is under investigation for "compromising operational and information security.".

changes.title: White House Correspondents’ Dinner Returns Under High Security
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is gearing up to attend the rescheduled White House Correspondents Dinner Friday night, after the initial event back in April was targeted by a gunman. The Secret Service says it’s confident in the security plan for the dinner while also acknowledging an alarming rise in threats. NBC’s Garrett Ha.

changes.title: Discovered by Atlas
changes.summary: The Secret Service first entered the public knowledge record with source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Secret Service warns of uptick in threats ahead of rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner
changes.summary: The Secret Service is warning about a rise in threats ahead of the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Dinner, which is set for Friday. CBS News' Nicole Sganga has the latest.

changes.title: Secret Service Agent in JD Vance’s Detail Under Investigation
changes.summary: The Secret Service said that a member of Vice President JD Vance’s team was accused of “compromising operational and information security.”.
